purpose: Train the accepted network on real single and double perturbations; a development pilot, not confirmation or SOTA claim.
external_embeddings: GenePT ada_text official Zenodo v2; fixed Gaussian 1536->64 projection, seed20261021, no RNA labels

single_pretraining.input: target gene and readout gene external embeddings ONLY
single_pretraining.target: log1p(CP10k) condition mean minus GFP+mCherry control mean

pair_training.calibration: refit with corresponding training pairs and ten singles
pair_training.M0: preserve archived endpoint shrink and fixed alpha0.5 noise0.3 gamma0.14684699381999897
pair_training.selection: pooled original-unit validation SSE across the same 21 validation pairs; step0 is baseline fallback; no outer truth
pair_training.refit: same selected number of gradient steps from pretrained state on all21 trainpairs
pair_training.fixed_terminal_candidate: also save 1000step raw candidate for diagnosis, never select it by outer outcomes

scope: One fixed development outer block, no single-query sequential tuning; all target halves and four-corner truth are score-only.
preprocessing: single profiles are centered across10 allowed singles; scale by global training-side RMS; response features are normalized single Gram coordinates; residual output scale from current training residual RMS.
termination: Complete one pretraining run, three fixed inner fits, one fixed outer refit; do not expand search after observing outer score.
